findings.title: Not in a Primary component
findings.text: wsrep_cluster_status is non-Primary: this node lost quorum or is not connected. Until it rejoins a Primary component it refuses most queries (SET, SHOW, SELECT without tables, reads of only information_schema or performance_schema tables, and reads with wsrep_dirty_reads still run).

notes: mysql.wsrep_cluster_members is written only for a Primary component, so on this node it lists the last Primary view; the members shown come from wsrep_incoming_addresses.

wsrep_incoming_addresses reports port 0 for galera-3, so only the host is shown: with wsrep_node_incoming_address AUTO the node takes the port mysqld had when wsrep started. Set wsrep_node_incoming_address to host:port to report the client port.
wsrep_flow_control_paused and the queue averages cover the time since the provider's statistics were last reset (FLUSH GLOBAL STATUS) or since start.
